mt: I'm impressed by the humble God.
en: Followers are moved by the god's humble ways.

ko: 함께 먹는 소박한 밥이 신앙을 키웁니다.
mt: The simple rice we eat together grows in faith.
en: Simple meals shared together nourish Piety.

mt: I like the school outside as well.
en: Even outsiders view the cult favorably.

mt: I buy less time for other gods.
en: You draw less envy from other gods.

mt: It's less visible to the gods.
en: You catch the gods' eyes less often.

mt: They're less suspicious of the world.
en: You draw less suspicion from the world.

mt: It takes a lot of time to put up with it.
Every year there's a silent rise in loyalty.
Each year, the faith deepens a little bit.
en: Each year, Piety deepens a little.

mt: It's the believers in any way.
en: Your followers hold out against any assault.

mt: It doesn't leave easy to convert.
en: They do not easily leave, even under conversion campaigns.

mt: Even when surrounded, it doesn't cool down.
en: Even under siege, Piety does not cool.

mt: You have a greater heart for others.
Behem draws people to the cult.
en: Generosity draws people to the cult.

mt: A reduction in the appeal is a reduction in the faith.
en: The relief line becomes a line of followers.

mt: I listen to healing with sharing.
A gracious neighbor wraps up a cult.

en: Neighbors stamp out bad rumors for you.

mt: The record of charity covers doubts.
en: A record of charity buries suspicion.
Word spreads of a clean cult.

mt: The more you open the book, the more you get a reputation.
en: The more you open the books, the higher your Reputation.

mt: The simple words move the faithful.
No dust, no dust, no dust.

en: Even when investigators come, you have little to lose.

mt: There's a way to avoid it.
en: You find ways to avoid seizure.

mt: There's less doubt in the world.
en: The world's suspicion builds up more slowly.
The heat of the flesh warms the vessel.

mt: The temptation is a deep bond between the believers.
The memory of the night that was chosen becomes a faith.
en: The memory of being chosen for a night becomes Piety.

mt: Pleasure restores the vessel more deeply.
en: Pleasure restores the vessel more deeply.

mt: The night of the day, flesh and flesh, they bring their bodies back to life.
en: Nights spent skin to skin revive the body.

mt: Pleasure covers the wounds of the mind.
en: Pleasure covers the wounds of the mind.

mt: The more you eat, the bigger the bowl.
en: The more you eat, the fuller the vessel grows.

mt: The rest of the world calls people together.
en: The feast table draws people in.

mt: Those who are out there become believers.
en: Those with full bellies become followers.

mt: A glass of wine builds faith.
en: A single cup of wine strengthens Faith.

mt: The bowl recovers as much as you ate and drank.
en: The vessel recovers as much as you eat and drink.

ko: 배부른 신도는 쌀자루를 따라 떠나지 않습니다.
mt: The full Shinto doesn't follow the rice sacks.
en: Well-fed followers never leave for someone else's rice sacks.

mt: The craving for wealth becomes powerful.
en: Your craving for riches becomes power.

ko: 더 큰 봉헌이 더 큰 축복을 부릅니다.
mt: A greater dedication is called a greater blessing.
The faithful make the dedication amount.
en: Followers compete over how much they offer.

mt: Money suppresses the doubts of the world.
The ends of the investigation are dulled.
en: The edge of the investigation is dulled.

mt: They move their property before they are seized.
en: You move your Wealth before it can be seized.

ko: 모든 것 위에 서려는 야망이 커집니다.
mt: The ambition to stand above everything becomes greater.
en: Your ambition to stand above all things grows.

mt: Take care of the Shinto religion of the other cults.
en: You swallow the followers of other cults.

mt: It's coming down from a height.
en: Majesty flows down from on high.

ko: 다른 신들 앞에서도 고개를 숙이지 않습니다.
mt: They don't bow their heads in front of other gods.
en: You refuse to bow your head even before other gods.

mt: There's less pressure on the new world.
en: Pressure from the heavens builds up more slowly.
Your majesty does not easily crumble.
